scope: Bounded profiling, not an A/B optimization benchmark. One retained Windows capture and one final Android capture per workload. Earlier Android attempts are excluded. Only player one consumes replay in four-player mode.

windows.provenance: Reused 2026-11-10 local build, CMake cache version 0.10.3. Source and patch inputs match 8d208f2; current HEAD differs in CMake version and documentation/packaging. Exact binary source revision is not embedded.
windows.profiling: WPR CPU.Verbose.File failed with 0xc5585011 (system profiling policy privilege). Fallback: GetThreadTimes over 15 s and temporary SuspendThread/GetThreadContext RIP sampler, Sleep(2), timeBeginPeriod(1), module relocation from Toolhelp. Not ETW or an on-CPU sampling profile.
windows.host_load: Background desktop work was not controlled; no A/B isolation is claimed. The Android cross-build had finished before these retained captures.

android.provenance: Fresh supported scripts/build_android.py generation/build/package at source_commit after PR 428. Release ARM64 native library; isolated debug Java shell, no native profiling probes added. Staged unstripped symbols match the installed stripped ELF build ID.
android.status: Two final foreground-validated 15 s user-CPU captures with complete 1526-update replays; zero sample loss and zero truncated stack samples.

previous_unmeasured_build.provenance: Freshly generated USA game/RSP sources and native build at source_commit. Separate debug Java profiling shell; native Release library unchanged.
previous_unmeasured_build.status: Native build confirmed. Capture pending issue 425 releasing the shared tablet; runtime settings below are intended, not an accepted measurement.

android.device_conditions: USB powered, no governor/affinity/frequency changes. Battery 100%, 26 C before the first capture; background Android services and thermal variation not controlled.
android.notes: Player app and its private files were not modified. Existing isolated-app ROM/assets/driver reused; this does not test launcher import or driver ZIP import.
